science.title: Certain fungi turn specialized plant cells into water-carrying cells using one protein
science.description: Can a pathogen that causes damage to a plant also make that plant more resilient to drought? An international research team led by the University of Göttingen has investigated this apparent paradox. The researchers discovered how certain fungi promote the formation of new water-conducting cells in plants. At the same time, infected plants showed increased tolerance to drought stress. The results were published in the journal Cell Host & Microbe.

science.title: Determination of contamination of various insulators using K-means Clustering algorithm under various environmental conditions
science.description: Environmental contamination of transmission-line insulators increases the leakage current and lowers the flashover voltage. Contamination arises from exposure to dust, moisture, rain, fog and other environmental agents, and contaminated insulators can cause flashover, grid outages and consequent economic losses. In this paper, a K-means clustering technique is proposed to assess the contamination level of various insulators under different environmental conditions. Artificial pollution tests were performed on insulators and their leakage current was recorded to evaluate insulator health. K-means clustering was applied to a dataset of 7000 insulator images, divided into training (5896), validation (364) and test (740) subsets, with the number of clusters fixed at K = 3 to match the low, medium and high contamination severity classes. Contamination was assessed through the electric potential, electric field strength, equivalent salt deposit density (ESDD), permittivity and leakage current, and the results were compared with conventional online monitoring reported in the literature. The effect of environmental conditions was analysed by applying salt and water contaminants to the insulators and evaluating the resulting contamination values. Because the study is based on artificially contaminated insulators, validation on naturally contaminated, field-aged insulators is identified as necessary future work.
